#!/usr/bin/env node
// a fixture CLI for the overlay tests; the test puts the kit's parts region where PARTS is
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

// ===== 1. one =====

const NAME = 'fixture';
// says hello
function greet(who) {
  return `hello ${who}`;
}
function whereAmI() { return path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)); }
function helper() { return 1; }
function other() { return 2; }
function serve() { return 'cli'; }
/* PARTS */

// ===== 2. two =====

function main() { return [greet(NAME), whereAmI(), helper(), other()]; }
